gbm_population_evidence.quote: EGFR Gene Mutation; Glioblastoma; MGMT-Unmethylated Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma
Pathological criteria: EGFRvIII+ GBM from most recent surgery, confirmed by a Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA)-certified lab using a next-generation sequencing panel.

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I trial tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of E-SYNC chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells after lymphodepleting chemotherapy in treating patients with EGFRvIII positive (+) glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: COHORT 1 (Dose Escalation): An estimated 6 to 15 participants with newly diagnosed EGFRvIII+ glioblastoma with O6-methylguanine-DNA methyl-transferase (MGMT) unmethylated status who have completed initial radiation therapy will be assigned to cohort 1.
received at least standard of care external beam radiotherapy (SOC EBRT) as initial therapy, with or without concurrent temozolomide (TMZ)

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is a CAR T-cell product (excluded type); cyclophosphamide and fludarabine are lymphodepleting conditioning (supportive, R6). EGFRvIII+ required for all participants (Cohort 2 additionally H-score >=150); not candidate-matched because the EGFRvIII-directed agent is a cell therapy, not a pharmacological candidate. MGMT unmethylated required for Cohort 1 only. Treatment setting: both cohorts enrol after initial SOC radiotherapy (first-line), coded newly_diagnosed, although conditions list 'Recurrent Glioblastoma'. First registered arm (DL1) lists no interventions but its text describes cyclophosphamide, fludarabine and E-SYNC T cells.
